Setup has taken back the `dinah` server entry from `.devin/mcp_config.json` and Dinah's section from `AGENTS.md` under <BASE>. Three things remain, and they are yours to do. Unset `DINAH_ACTOR` and `DINAH_HARNESS`, together with any `DINAH_PROVIDER` and `DINAH_MODEL` you set yourself, in the environment you start Devin from. Where you copied the marked block into another rules file because your build did not name `AGENTS.md`, delete that copy yourself, because setup took back only the section it wrote in `AGENTS.md`. Where you registered the server in Devin's web application as well, remove it there, under Customize and then MCPs. Start Devin again afterwards.
